section.name: Record Payload Protection
section.t: The record protection functions translate a TLSPlaintext structure into a TLSCiphertext structure.

The length (in bytes) of the following TLSCiphertext.encrypted_record, which is the sum of the lengths of the content and the padding. The length MUST NOT exceed 2^14 + 256 bytes. An endpoint that receives a record that exceeds this length MUST terminate the connection with a "record_overflow" alert.
